high_level_description: The image appears to be a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "thirdeye.spiritual." The post features a graphic with symbols representing the four elements of fire, air, water, and earth, along with a quote attributed to Hermes Trismegistus from "The Emerald Tablet." Symbols of the Four Elements: The left side of the image displays four geometric shapes, each labeled with one of the four classical elements: Fire: Represented by an upward-pointing triangle. Air: Represented by a downward-pointing triangle.
